title: Sleep-EDF Bronze Schema
description: Expected schema for raw Sleep-EDF files ingested into Bronze layer

path.description: Full path to the EDF file in cloud storage

content.description: Binary content of the EDF file (Base64 encoded)

ingestion_time.description: Timestamp when file was ingested into Bronze layer

subject_id.description: Subject identifier extracted from filename (e.g., SC4001)

file_type.description: Type of EDF file: PSG (polysomnography) or Hypnogram (sleep stages)
